g.text: Customer 360 — UAT Deployment (GreenNode / VNG Cloud, HCM03-1C)
monitoring + tracing · co-located on c360-api-uat-api (10.100.1.5) · Keycloak-SSO-gated
Ops tools (Dagster :3000 · Netdata :19999 · Portainer :9443) -> reach via the LB IP 103.245.254.29, NOT the
beta.leocdp.com hostname (leocdp.com HSTS/includeSubDomains forces valid-cert HTTPS on the whole host).
Jaeger is the exception: fronted by Caddy at https://beta.leocdp.com/jaeger (:443 TLS, valid cert) -> use the hostname there.
